name: UI Frameworks
description: Component-based UI framework knowledge: React core, component architecture patterns, state management solutions, React hooks, Vue.js core, Svelte core, virtual DOM internals, client-side routing, component design patterns, and rendering performance optimization.

subskills.name: React Core
subskills.description: JSX, functional components, props, useState, useEffect lifecycle, conditional rendering.

subskills.name: Component Architecture
subskills.description: Composition over inheritance, compound components, render props, children patterns, slot-like APIs.

subskills.name: State Management
subskills.description: Context API, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Jotai, signal-based state, global vs local state boundaries.

subskills.name: React Hooks (Advanced)
subskills.description: Custom hooks, useRef, useMemo, useCallback, useReducer, useId, rules of hooks.

subskills.name: Vue.js Core
subskills.description: Vue 3 template syntax, Composition API (ref, reactive, computed, watch), v-model, provide/inject.

subskills.name: Svelte Core
subskills.description: Svelte reactive declarations ($:), stores (writable, derived), bind directives, compile-time approach.

subskills.name: Virtual DOM & Reconciliation
subskills.description: Virtual DOM diffing, React Fiber architecture, reconciliation algorithm, key-based list optimization.

subskills.name: Client-Side Routing
subskills.description: React Router v6, Vue Router, dynamic routes, route guards, nested layouts, lazy route loading.

subskills.name: Component Design Patterns
subskills.description: Higher-Order Components, headless/renderless components, controlled vs uncontrolled, provider pattern.

subskills.name: Rendering Performance Patterns
subskills.description: React.memo, useMemo/useCallback for re-render prevention, lazy/Suspense, windowing/virtualization.

github.signal: React Router or Vue Router usage

cv.signal: Component library or design system development

linkedin.signal: Frontend architecture or design systems experience

junior.description: Builds components in React or Vue, understands composition, and implements client-side routing.

mid.description: Writes custom hooks, architects state management, and has breadth across multiple frameworks.

senior.description: Understands framework internals, designs reusable component APIs, and optimizes rendering performance.
